answer_result.answer: Dave took the Boston clock tower photo in September 2023, described as 'last month' on 2023-10-29.

question.question: When did Dave take a photo of a Boston clock tower?

evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Hey Dave! Since we last talked, I went to a networking event to meet more artists. So cool! The people I met will help me build up my fan base. Super excited about what it could lead to. You? Anything new since we last spoke?
[S27T1] (dia_id: D27:1)

Dave: Hey Calvin! That's cool that you've been networking with other artists. Nice! I've been getting into photography recently. I've seen some amazing places and taken some great shots. Would you like to see them?
[S27T2] (dia_id: D27:2)

Calvin: Yeah, show me what you got!
[S27T3] (dia_id: D27:3)

Dave: Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!
[Image caption: a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower]
[S27T4] (dia_id: D27:4)

Calvin: Wow, that view looks awesome! What city is it? Have you taken any good pictures lately?
[S27T5] (dia_id: D27:5)

Dave: That's Boston, Cal! Check this out, I took this picture last month, and got a great shot - it was stunning!
[Image caption: a photography of a clock tower in a city with buildings]
[S27T6] (dia_id: D27:6)

Calvin: Wow, that pic is amazing! In your last photo, is that the clock tower? I was there a few years back, it's such a beautiful city. You're so talented, Dave!
[S27T7] (dia_id: D27:7)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot. Yep, that's the clock tower in the last photo. I snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning. Photography helps me capture and appreciate the beauty of nature. It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it.
[S27T8] (dia_id: D27:8)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! Sounds like you're having a blast with your photography. Hope it's bringing you lots of joy. By the way, how is your car project going?
[S27T9] (dia_id: D27:9)

Dave: Hey Calvin, photography has been great for me! The car project is doing well - I just finished restoring it and it looks amazing. Wanna come by and check it out? How's everything with the music? Any updates?
[S27T10] (dia_id: D27:10)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Your car project sounds amazing. I've had some great collaborations recently and my album is almost finished. I'll send you some previews soon. Let me know when you're free for a catch-up.
[S27T11] (dia_id: D27:11)

Dave: Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it. Let me know when you're free and take it easy!
[S27T12] (dia_id: D27:12)

- On 2023-11-17, after Calvin closed the nature-photo exchange with a photo he shot in a Japanese garden (a bench under a tree with pink flowers), Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Found an even better spot, with a bench under a tree with pink flowers - so peaceful. A perfect spot to relax and take in the beauty." — describing the same bench-under-a-pink-flower-tree scene as "a spot" he found, and Calvin: "That sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to see it." [S30T17][S30T18]; Dave then shared it — "Check it out, Calvin. It's really calming, I think you'll like it." — and the two agreed "We will definitely go there!" (a plan to visit the spot together; if it is the same Japanese-garden scene Calvin photographed, the two have found a shared favorite, though Calvin's photo is the only image attached to it so far) [S30T19].
- On 2023-10-29, told Calvin he's been getting into photography recently — he's "seen some amazing places and taken some great shots" — and offered to show Calvin them (Calvin: "Yeah, show me what you got!") [S27T2][S27T3].
- Shared two Boston photos with Calvin on 2023-10-29: first, a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower — "Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!" (Calvin: "Wow, that view looks awesome!") [S27T4][S27T5]; second, a photo of the clock tower in the city with buildings around it, which he took last month (~September 2023) — "got a great shot - it was stunning!" (Calvin: "Wow, that pic is amazing!") [S27T6].
- When Calvin recognized the clock tower ("In your last photo, is that the clock tower?"), Dave confirmed it is the clock tower — he snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning [S27T7][S27T8].
- On 2023-10-29, said photography helps him capture and appreciate the beauty of nature — "It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it." (his appreciation of nature echoes his park walks — see ## Parks; Calvin: "You're so talented, Dave!", to which Dave said "Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot.") (Calvin's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S27T8].
- On 2023-10-25, when Calvin told him he'd enjoyed sightseeing in Boston the day before (2023-10-24), said Boston has "so much to do" and mentioned one of his favorites there that is "great for chilling and admiring nature" (consistent with his Boston-parks remarks, see above and ## Parks); Calvin: "I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful." [S26T2][S26T3].

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them. I hope my music can reach a global audience and make an impact. I'm also looking forward to my upcoming trip to Boston after I finish the Frank Ocean tour. I've heard that the music scene there is awesome, so I can't wait to check it out!
[S3T9] (dia_id: D3:9)

Dave: Sounds like an amazing plan, Cal! I can't wait for your trip to Boston. I'll show you around town and all the cool spots. The music scene there is awesome, with places like Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. You'll definitely have some great performances there. Count me in for the front row when you're up onstage! Oh, and by the way, check out this pic.
[Image caption: a photography of a city skyline with a boat in the water]
[S3T10] (dia_id: D3:10)

Calvin: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!
[S3T11] (dia_id: D3:11)

Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
[Image caption: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass]
[S3T12] (dia_id: D3:12)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!
[Image caption: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show]
[S3T13] (dia_id: D3:13)

Dave: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?
[S3T14] (dia_id: D3:14)

Calvin: Not yet, been pretty busy with rehearsals and traveling. But I'm looking forward to exploring the city, trying out some delicious food, and visiting the popular attractions. Maybe we can grab a bite together when I'm there?
[S3T15] (dia_id: D3:15)

Dave: Definitely, Cal! Let's grab some food and I'll show you my favorite spots in the city. Can't wait to show them to you!
[S3T16] (dia_id: D3:16)

Calvin: Sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to try out the food there with you. It'll be fun!
[S3T17] (dia_id: D3:17)

Dave: It'll be great, Cal! Can't wait to show you the amazing music and food here. See you soon!
[S3T18] (dia_id: D3:18)

- On 2023-10-29, while looking at Dave's Boston photos (the sunset-over-the-skyline photo and a close-up of the clock tower, see the 2023-10-29 entry in ## Music and the Photography section of /memories/dave.md), Calvin recognized the clock tower and said he was in Boston a few years back — "it's such a beautiful city." (a second, separate Boston visit, in addition to his late-2023-08/early-2023-09 visit above; "a few years back" — exact date not given) [S27T5][S27T7].
- On 2023-11-13, told Dave he invited his old high school friend (the same friend he sightseeing'd with on 2023-10-24, see above) to see him perform in Boston — "It was insane!" — (recent as of 2023-11-13; the show date itself is not specified) (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S29T1].
- On 2023-11-16, attended a "fancy gala" in Boston (told Dave about it on 2023-11-17, as "yesterday") and met some interesting people; shared a photo of himself and "the crew" (a photography of a group of men sitting on a rock next to a river) (Dave: "that event looks amazing! You all look awesome."; the Boston event — details in the 2023-11-17 entry of ## Relationships) [S30T2].

Dave: Wow, Calvin! That's amazing news! Congratulations on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance. I can't wait to hear all about it and maybe even catch one of your shows in Boston. Let me know when you're free to catch up. Cheers to your musical journey!

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'll catch you when I'm in Boston. Cheers!
[S30T22] (dia_id: D30:22)

Dave: Looking forward to seeing you. Stay safe, talk to you soon!

Calvin: Thanks! You too. Talk to you later!
